consequence.statement: Pod annotations using policy.cilium.io/proxy-visibility will no longer be honored and L7 protocol visibility configuration via this annotation will be ignored.

original.statement: Pod annotation policy.cilium.io/proxy-visibility, deprecated since v1.15, has been removed in Cilium 1.17.0.

decision.reason: [ev-7424e74176c0] says support for L7 protocol visibility through the Pod annotation `policy.cilium.io/proxy-visibility` "has been removed" in the 1.17 upgrade notes. That means the annotation is still set but no longer honoured. Pods that carry it stop getting L7 visibility through it, which fits setting-ignored (mandatory work). It is not a deprecation, because the feature no longer works.
